question: What arises in the head by repeating this knife?
premises: The one-and-half-syllabled night of time is called knife in Malini view.
By hundred repetition pain arises in the head.
inference: Therefore repeating this knife one hundred times produces head pain.
plain_english: In Malini view, the one-and-half-syllabled night of time is the knife; by repeating it one hundred times, pain arises in the head.
